notes: Definition type change, same type: the type of `UpperTheory.Reformulated.B.SpecialLinearMap.slM` changes from `MultilinearMap ℂ W (W v)` to `MultilinearMap (RingHom.id ℂ) W (W v)`. `MultilinearMap` now takes the ring homomorphism explicitly (semilinear multilinear maps), and `MultilinearMap (RingHom.id ℂ)` is the target's ordinary ℂ-multilinear map (the `→ₘₗ[ℂ]` notation unfolds to it). The definition body is the same; add `RingHom.id_apply` to one `simp` set in the `map_update_smul'` proof.
